name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: A standard template for general meetings, focusing on key outcomes and actions.

sections.title: 摘要
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the entire meeting.

sections.title: 关键决策
sections.instruction: List the most important decisions made during the meeting.

sections.title: 待办事项
sections.instruction: MANDATORY: List every explicit task, follow-up, commitment, owner and deadline. Use a concise bullet list in the form `- Owner — task — due date`. Use `Unassigned` or `No due date` when absent. If none were explicitly assigned, write exactly `No explicit action items were identified.` Do not omit this heading.

sections.title: 讨论要点
sections.instruction: Summarize the main topics of discussion, key arguments, and important insights.
